gloss: occupied territory; occupied land; conquered area

definitions.gloss: occupied territory; occupied land; conquered area

examples.japanese: {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: The residents of the occupied territory suffered.

examples.japanese: {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}→撤退：12822_tettai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The withdrawal from the occupied territory was decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧、{連合国|れんごうこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{占領地|せんりょうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{行政機関|ぎょうせいきかん}→行政機関：30276_gyouseikikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: After the war, the Allied powers established new administrative bodies in the occupied territories.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{占領|せんりょう}→占領：11863_senryou⟧ (occupation, military seizure) + {地|ち} (land/territory). Refers to land controlled by a foreign military power or conquering force. Commonly encountered in history textbooks, news coverage of conflicts, and political discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{統治|とうち}→統治：13842_touchi⟧: governance of occupied territory
- {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}→撤退：12822_tettai⟧: withdrawal from occupied territory
- {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents of occupied territory
- {占領地|せんりょうち}⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧: occupied territory administration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {占領区|せんりょうく}: occupied zone/sector (smaller administrative division within occupied territory)
- ⟦{植民地|しょくみんち}→植民地：16073_shokuminchi⟧: colony (territory exploited economically over a long period, not just militarily held)
- ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧: territory (one's own sovereign territory; neutral term)

ETYMOLOGY:
In Japanese history, the term is most associated with the post-WWII Allied occupation of Japan (1945-1952) and Japan's own wartime occupations in Asia.
